jobs.title: Healthcare Technical Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare systems/operations fit: operational excellence for health-plan technology delivery, SLA reporting, root-cause analysis, Jira/ServiceNow, vendor coordination, project tracking and process setup across enrollment, claims and payment workflows.
jobs.gap: The role prefers direct payer-platform experience such as Facets/QNXT/NASCO and production incident-management depth. Emphasize healthcare operations, system workflows, vendor coordination and process improvement without overstating payer-core technical experience.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Operational Programs
jobs.why: Exceptional behavioral-health operations match spanning clinician onboarding, dashboards, workflow redesign, automation/AI, operating models, root-cause analysis and cross-functional execution across Data, Product, Engineering and Clinical teams.
jobs.gap: The senior-manager level expects roughly 4–6+ years of operations/program/implementation ownership and strong quantitative fluency. Position cumulative operations, BA, training and project leadership clearly while keeping SQL only at foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Practice Operations Manager II
jobs.why: Direct healthcare-operations role covering clinical-practice workflows, staff leadership, scheduling, KPIs, dashboards, project implementation, process evaluation, performance improvement, change management and cross-functional coordination.
jobs.gap: Physician-practice management and direct supervisory experience are preferred, so the resume should foreground healthcare intake/operations leadership, training, workflow ownership and measurable process improvements.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong health-tech operator role focused on client-launch playbooks, training, dashboards/KPIs, Intake and Care Operations, cross-functional execution and automation with Engineering—closely aligned with current healthcare operations and systems work.
jobs.gap: The role expects 4–5 years in business operations, strategy or consulting and comfort operating in a fast-growth startup. Make cumulative operations/BA experience explicit and quantify ownership wherever possible.

jobs.title: Scheduling and Operational Excellence Manager
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare operations fit involving workflow evaluation, scheduling effectiveness, clinical integration, performance data, process improvement, patient-care coordination and cross-functional execution across clinical, operational, financial and vendor teams.
jobs.gap: The compensation ceiling is modest relative to the target and direct wound-care/scheduling leadership may be preferred. Emphasize healthcare workflow coordination, intake operations, training and process redesign.

jobs.title: Revenue Cycle & Claims Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare startup role combining Medicaid managed-care workflows, provider setup, credentialing/linkage, claims operations, process building, systems improvement and cross-functional execution across Operations, Clinical, Product, Data and Finance.
jobs.gap: This is a stretch because it requires 7+ years of hands-on medical billing/RCM leadership, denials, A/R and payer-specific claims expertise. Apply only with truthful positioning of adjacent Medicaid/intake/credentialing experience rather than implying full RCM ownership.

jobs.title: Deployment Program Manager
jobs.location: Remote · Company based in New York City
jobs.why: Healthcare technology program role focused on deploying operational technology into health systems, coordinating complex implementations and improving care operations. Strong project/program-management and cross-functional systems fit.
jobs.gap: Likely expects deeper enterprise deployment and technical implementation experience than the current profile. Lead with systems project management, stakeholder coordination and implementation work without overstating technical architecture expertise.

jobs.title: Technical Support Operations Manager
jobs.location: United States · Remote eligible / San Francisco hybrid preference
jobs.why: Healthcare-AI operations role with strong overlap in operational systems, process improvement, reporting, support workflows and cross-functional coordination in a fast-growing clinical technology company.
jobs.gap: Technical support operations and radiology-software depth may be stronger than the current background, and San Francisco candidates may be prioritized. Position BA/systems operations experience clearly and avoid implying engineering-level expertise.

jobs.title: Project Implementation Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid (3+ days in office)
jobs.why: Health-tech SaaS implementation role centered on enterprise client delivery, documentation, project timelines, onboarding and cross-functional execution. Good bridge between healthcare operations and formal implementation management.
jobs.gap: The salary floor is well below target and enterprise SaaS implementation experience is preferred. Pursue only if compensation can land near the top of range and emphasize project delivery plus healthcare systems exposure.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.why: Fresh biotech operations role covering workflow/SOP development, reporting, retail onboarding, cross-functional coordination and revenue operations across Sales, Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain and Legal. Strong systems-and-process fit without SEO being central.
jobs.gap: The role is more commercial/marketplace operations than healthcare service operations, and the salary floor is below target. Use Resume C and foreground CRM/process/reporting experience rather than SEO.
